subsample: every 5th env of the 5000 LHS, collapsed under nominal params (369 envs)
second_pass_verification: every collapsed flag re-verified from a fresh solve; 0 mismatches (an earlier run caught and fixed a subsample-index mapping bug before any results were kept)

direction_aware_supplementary.glucose_cap: FVA min == uptake bound in 25/25 (cannot take up more glucose at the optimum)
direction_aware_supplementary.glycerol_drain: FVA min == drain bound in 25/25 (drain cannot be reduced at the optimum)

gate_G3.criterion: at least one bottleneck cluster supported by both binding/dual evidence and FVA across >=10% of collapsed environments
gate_G3.verdict: MET IN SUBSTANCE for two clusters, with a stated caveat
gate_G3.detail: glycerol_drain binds in 138/369 collapsed envs (37%) with mean shadow price 0.37 ethanol per unit drain; glucose_cap binds in 118/369 (32%) with mean shadow price 0.58. FVA direction check is consistent in 25/25 solved envs for both. Caveat: under the strict pre-declared FVA-forced-width criterion, only the ethanol_cap cluster passes, and that cap is model-imposed (objective carrier), so it is not an independent discovery. NGAM FVA is vacuous (fixed bound). growth_cap binds in 39 envs but with zero shadow price (degenerate).
open_gaps: FVA solved on 25 of 50 sampled envs (25 nonviable/infeasible); 25/369 = 6.8% coverage vs the 10% gate denominator if read over all collapsed envs - binding coverage (369/369) is what the 10% figures above use
strict FVA-forced criterion not met by informative clusters; direction-aware FVA for lb-type constraints is partially by construction
ethanol_cap near-universal binding (197/199) is expected by model construction, not a finding

finding: Productivity collapse in combined-stress environments is co-limited by two mechanisms: (1) obligatory osmoregulatory glycerol production draining carbon (binds in 69% of solvable collapsed envs, shadow price ~0.37), and (2) heat-driven glycolytic capacity loss binding glucose uptake (binds in 59%, shadow price ~0.58). Both dominate the model-imposed ethanol inhibition cap as intervention targets: relieving the glycerol drain or the glucose-uptake cap yields positive marginal ethanol in collapsed environments, while the growth cap is degenerate.
